title: Widen the label-value grammar to accept @-prefixed addresses
description:
Widen the label value character class so a value may begin with `@` (optionally followed by a project name and a deeper `/`-delimited path), while leaving the single-colon namespace split untouched.

## Background

Today's canonical label regex lives in `crates/jit/src/labels.rs:22-26` (the `label_regex()`/`LABEL_REGEX` static): `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/-]*$`. The value class (`[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/-]*`) has no `@`, so an address of the form `@/rule/label-format` or `@myproject/gate/cargo-ci` cannot be authored as a label value at all — `validate_label` rejects it outright before any resolution logic ever sees it.

The grammar must admit a leading `@`, an optional project name (`[a-z][a-z0-9-]*` — same character shape as the existing namespace pattern), and one or more `/`-delimited path segments after it, alongside the existing (unqualified and `/`-qualified-link) value forms. The single-colon namespace split (`label.splitn(2, ':')` at `labels.rs:77` and the equivalent in `suggest_label_fix` near `labels.rs:187`) is a separate concern and must not change — colon remains reserved as the sole namespace separator, so a value containing a colon anywhere continues to be rejected by the widened grammar (no code needs to touch the splitn calls themselves for this change).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `validate_label`/`label_regex()` accepts `enforces:@/rule/label-format` (bare `@`, no project name) and `enforces:@myproject/gate/cargo-ci` (`@` + project name), each with a `/`-delimited path after the `@`-segment.
- [hard] REQ-02: previously-valid forms keep validating with no regression: `milestone:v1.0`, `type:task`, and the existing qualified-link form `satisfies:56ab0224/REQ-01`.
- [hard] REQ-03: a value with a colon anywhere after the namespace separator is rejected, e.g. `enforces:@/rule:label-format` and `enforces:@bad:name/rule/x` both fail `validate_label`.
- [hard] REQ-04: new unit tests are added to the `mod tests` block in `crates/jit/src/labels.rs` (alongside `test_validate_label_valid_formats` et al.) covering both the newly-accepted `@`-forms and the newly-exercised rejected-colon-in-value forms.
- [hard] REQ-05: `cargo test --lib` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` pass with zero warnings.

## Notes

The exact regex construction (e.g. an alternation between the `@`-branch and the legacy branch) is an implementation choice; no single canonical pattern is dictated upstream — only the accepted/rejected forms above are binding.
